[[Private/Legends|Private]] '''Finn''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a member of the [[Eighty-first Infantry]]. He was stationed with the rest of his company above [[Voss]], where they saw no action whatsoever. After the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|leader]] [[Havoc Squad]] convinced [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Evran]] to re-deploy the Eighty-first elsewhere, Finn and the rest of the men were extremely grateful.
